description: Closed allowlist of tools a builder agent may receive. Every entry is read-only. The enum in agent-draft.schema.json must equal the list of names below, in this order. Contract owner: docs/agent-platform/design-agent-builder.md.

tools.name: k8s_get_resources
tools.summary: List resources of one type, optionally in one namespace.
tools.summaryPt: Lista recursos de um tipo, opcionalmente em um namespace.

tools.name: k8s_get_resource_yaml
tools.summary: Read the YAML of one resource. Secrets are denied by the tool server RBAC.
tools.summaryPt: Lê o YAML de um recurso. Secrets são negados pelo RBAC do tool server.

tools.name: k8s_describe_resource
tools.summary: Describe one resource, including recent events.
tools.summaryPt: Descreve um recurso, incluindo eventos recentes.

tools.name: k8s_get_events
tools.summary: List events, optionally in one namespace.
tools.summaryPt: Lista eventos, opcionalmente em um namespace.

tools.name: k8s_get_pod_logs
tools.summary: Read the last lines of a pod log.
tools.summaryPt: Lê as últimas linhas do log de um pod.
